profile.headline: Manager of Analytics Tooling at Expedia Group
profile.summary:
Accomplished Senior Manager with over 20 years of experience at Fortune 500 companies, specializing in solving large-scale computing challenges. Strong background as a software engineer, who has developed solutions in multiple programming languages, including PERL, C++, Python, Java, and SQL. His expertise spans both transactional systems and distributed computing platforms such as Oracle, Cassandra, MongoDB, and Data Lakes.

Currently supporting Expedia Group’s analytics tooling, enabling access to its petabyte-scale data lake. Has extensive experience managing and supporting both open-source and enterprise-grade tools, as well as vendor partnerships and contracts.  Some contracts worked on include Github, Gitlab, Nexus, Starburst Trino, Celerdata Starrocks, Databricks and Tableau.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Manager
positions.description: Managed a group of developers who stood up and maintained internal configurations of best in class Analytics tools such as Databricks, Tableau, Looker, Querybook, Trino, Starrocks, & JupyterHub.  We use SQL, terraform, python and Java.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: Managed a group of developers standing up and maintaining the Expedia Group Datalake.  Technologies used were Hive/Hadoop, Terraform, Java Services, on AWS.  We helped maintain replication and optimization tools tools written in house and open sourced.  These tools can be referenced at github.com/Expedia/apiary

positions.title: Build and Delivery Manager
positions.description: At the Walt Disney Company during these times, they used Jenkins, Gitlab, Github, Nexus and various other build automation tools.  Worked with many many different teams within Disney to help them build their software and deliver artifacts to production environments.  We used AWS and Kubernetes to host these services.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: Managed a group of developers who authored and maintained RESTful services pertaining to Guest/Fan (customer) logins.  These services followed the OAuth2 pattern and were written mostly in Java backed by Cassandra, MongoDB, and SQL Server on AWS.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintained and authored RESTful API's and services that serviced OAuth2 backed Guest/Fan logins.  These services were mostly written in Java and backed by Cassandra, MongoDB, and SQL Server.  Towards the promotion, I helped to rigorously interview to build out my own team and a few extra sister teams in the same group as well.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on software stack mostly written in Java to serve federal agencies hiring efforts.  Half way through, switched to working in C# in MonoDevelop to help to prototype and demo iOS apps to aid federal Human Resource processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: MorphoTrak is the world leader in multibiometric technologies for fingerprint, iris and facial recognition, and an acknowledged expert in identification systems. Its solutions meet a wide range of security needs for people, companies and governments worldwide, including identity management, personal rights for residents and travelers, physical access to airports or other high-value sites, and logical access, either online or via secure terminals.

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer, Data Warehouse
positions.description: Amazon, is the global leader in e-commerce. Amazon has extensive product offerings, international sites, and worldwide network of fulfillment and customer service centers. Today, Amazon offers everything from books and electronics to tennis rackets and diamond jewelry. Operations are in in Canada, China, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Spain and United Kingdom and maintain dozens of fulfillment centers around the world which encompass more than 26 million square feet.
